parsed.notes:
Ihre Qualifikationen defaults to required; idealerweise makes SAFe optional, and von Vorteil makes the three named agent-platform products optional.
Alternative group 1 comprises the illustrative coding tools; unmapped Kiro CLI is also an alternative in that set.
The named agent-platform products are treated literally as distinct products, not silently mapped to their broader platforms or to GitHub Copilot.
Halluzinationen asks for understanding hallucinations, not explicitly hallucination detection, so it remains unmapped.
Softwareentwicklung describes the context of AI-tool use rather than a separate software-engineering qualification.
Security, Datenschutz and Compliance occur as characteristics of optional industry/organizational experience, not separate technical qualifications.
Technologies and practices appearing only under Ihre Aufgaben are excluded.
Seniority is uncertain: mehrjährige experience supports mid, while the only numeric minimum is 12 months of AI-tool experience; no level is stated.
